scripts.port_scope: Liquidity top/bottom/count state, rolling-extreme matches, sweep-label and anchor events, persistent profile bounds/origins, causal last-bar bins and POC.
scripts.input_contract: Finite repository OHLC, finite nonnegative Volume, unique increasing timezone-aware index of bar opens; explicit duration and optional as_of enforce completed-bar availability. OHLC+nonnegative Volume. ATR100*.2 bin spacing; full volume allocated by close to one bin; exclude out-of-range closes without clamping.
scripts.state_contract: Source profile drawing is barstate.islast only; every historical row is a completed-prefix last-bar snapshot. Preserve counter increment/fade/anchor/sweep order and na comparisons. A price-change sweep is not a trade entry.
scripts.availability_contract: Every feature row uses bar-close available_at; origin and drawing indices are metadata only. Historical profile states are immutable causal snapshots.
fixture_edges_pending: ATR warmup/zero ATR do not create a profile. All-zero bins retain the source first-maximum mathematical POC but report unusable profile. Drawing widths divide by zero there; graphics omitted.

scripts.name: HTF Log-Regression Volume Profile [BigBeluga]
scripts.author: BigBeluga
scripts.port_scope: Developing and completed HTF high/low/mid, source log-regression endpoints and bands, directional volume and delta, regression-relative bins, POC curve/drawing coordinates, explicit completion and availability metadata.
scripts.input_contract: Finite repository OHLC, finite nonnegative Volume, unique increasing timezone-aware index of bar opens; explicit duration and optional as_of enforce completed-bar availability. Exact aligned nonmissing boolean Pine timeframe.change flags required; optional htf_period attrs must match selected period. On15m source auto period is2D. No request.security or UTC-resample approximation.
scripts.state_contract: Regression fits reverse chronological log(close) at x1..N but evaluates reg_end at x0 and bin centers at xi; retain extrapolation. First false boundary flag makes an incomplete initial session; new HTF resets length1. Completed profile appears only after the next session is observed and never backfills.
scripts.availability_contract: Every feature row uses bar-close available_at; origin and drawing indices are metadata only. Historical profile states are immutable causal snapshots.
fixture_edges_pending: Positive Close required. One-bar regression denominator yields na. Constant/zero channel height is reported undefined instead of inventing a zero-width bin. Main adapter supports fixed-duration minute charts; full auto-timeframe mapping utility separately preserves source string distinctions.
Exported TradingView numerical/state fixtures on identical data/feed, timestamp and calculation-origin inputs.
Pine stdev/ATR seeding and float comparison/bin-floor boundaries.
